adjudication.rationale: The diff shows the new update spec uses `xhr :put, :update, id: 1, name: "WAT", visible: "true"` and then `Group.find(1)`, without fabricating/setting up that group in the example (unlike other specs that `Fabricate(:group, automatic: true)`). That makes the test dependent on a “magic” existing group with id=1. Also, the updated controller logic now conditionally renames only when `!group.automatic` (`group.name = params[:name] if params[:name] && !group.automatic`), but the new spec only exercises the automatic-group branch and does not verify the non-automatic rename behavior (the prior assertion that a group’s name changed during update was removed along with the old update-members test). This is a concrete test coverage/brittleness issue grounded in the diff, not a direct functional bug in the application logic.
